items.quote: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.
items.claim: Abraham built an altar, arranged wood upon it, bound his son Isaac, and placed him on the altar
items.action: built altar, laid wood, bound, laid upon altar
items.place: the place which God had told him of
